additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Jason,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R9 1700028471
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
qI1nBM
Problem Description
: SCB is offline
Troubleshooting
:
It seems like there was a power loss to the Router 1 and we lost all connection to the logs.
You reported to me directly that, via OCPP, we are able to see the charger online and working.
My feeling is that the router is offline.
You just need to send someone on-site and check if the Router is really turned off, LEDs are off.
If yes, please remove the 24V and reinsert.
Please take a spare router with you in case we need to replace it.
If there is no need you can just send it back to factory without opening the package and you will be reimbursed.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0366682
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
